outputs.explanation: The top bar chart in panel A shows mean±s.d. cell death from three independent experiments, but individual data points from each replicate are not overlaid on the bars.
The bar chart in panel B shows cell death percentages as bars without any error bars or individual data points overlaid, so the underlying replicate data are not shown.
The bar chart shows mean±s.d. of three experiments at each time point for EGFP, EGFP-HIPK2 and EGFP-K221R conditions, but individual data points are not displayed.
The bar chart in panel D displays cell death percentages with error bars but no individual data points overlaid to show the underlying replicate measurements.
